dateline: With the ARIRANG World Tour paused between Chicago and Los Angeles, BTS's off-stage numbers keep climbing: the Korean Business Research Institute ranked the group No. 2 in its August Star Brand Reputation Rankings (Aug 29), and Billboard's World Albums chart carried four BTS catalog titles for the week ending Aug 29 — 'Proof,' 'Love Yourself: Answer,' 'Map of the Soul: 7 ~The Journey~,' and 'Love Yourself: Tear.' SoFi Stadium opened an early merch sale (Aug 31) ahead of the tour's North American leg resuming with four sold-out Los Angeles shows (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6).
heroHeadline: Day 4,827: SoFi Stadium Opens Early Merch Sale Ahead of BTS's Four Los Angeles Shows
heroSubtitle: August 31, 2026 is Day 4,827 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Ahead of the ARIRANG World Tour's four sold-out Los Angeles shows at SoFi Stadium (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6), the venue opened a non-event-day early merchandise sale (10 a.m.-6 p.m. at Lake Park near Lot N and Lot K, with free parking). The stop follows a brief tour pause after the Chicago Soldier Field stand (Aug 27-28), during which the Korean Business Research Institute's August Star Brand Reputation Rankings placed BTS second overall (Aug 29) and Billboard's World Albums chart carried four BTS catalog titles for the week ending Aug 29 (Aug 30).
